scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @hub/api" "npm run dev -w @hub/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hub/shared && npm run test -w @hub/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run setup
